record.question: The nurse taking care of a patient with chest tube drainage suddenly notices that there is no fluctuation in the water seal tube. Which of the following action should the nurse take first?
options: Turn the patient to the unaffected side
Check the tubing to ensure there is no kinking
record.explanation: Answer C: Check the tubing to ensure there is no kinking. First inspect the drainage system for kinking or obstruction when water-seal fluctuation stops; absence can also reflect lung re-expansion, so assess the patient and system before intervention. Source/context note: A sudden change requires patient assessment and escalation if symptoms or obstruction are present; do not milk the tube. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK459199/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
